change: All Wk3 icuWorkoutText rewritten from bare zone notation (Z1, Z2, Z4) to explicit percent-of-LTHR ranges against LTHR 180, so the Send-to-watch push constrains heart rate rather than pace or power. Mapping used: Z1 70-84%, Z2 84-89%, Z3 89-94%, Z4 94-99%. Wed 29 work steps are 94-98% LTHR (170-176bpm). Mon 27 bike set lower at 65-75% LTHR since 180 is a running LTHR and cycling threshold HR sits below it. steps[].target left in Z-notation because the site's timeline visual parses the zone from that field.
reason: In intervals.icu syntax a bare zone resolves to the sport's default target, which is pace for runs and power for rides, so every workout pushed to Garmin so far has carried pace alerts rather than HR alerts. Heart rate targets must be marked explicitly with HR or LTHR. On mountain terrain a pace target is meaningless and actively misleading, and HR is the only constraint that transfers across gradient, altitude and fatigue. Needs verification on the first push: confirm the Garmin shows an HR alert range and not a pace range.

change: Fixed a repeat-block syntax bug in icuWorkoutText across every interval session (Jul 21, Jul 23, Jul 28, Aug 6, Aug 13): the rep-count line was written as a dashed step ("- 6x") with no blank-line padding, which intervals.icu's parser does not recognize as a repeat header.
